# Loop starts keep the loop at least 17 samples long. A 16-sample loop (start 16, end 32) with a
# remaining count that is not a multiple of 16 makes the original underflow its remaining count and
# never return (both sides abort at the budget); that state is outside the decoder's domain.
field 0281CA5C 54001110 u32 0,1,15
field 0281CA5C 54001114 u32 32,64,128,256,1024
field 0281CA5C 54001118 u32 0x54020000
